problem: Find $c$ such that the average value of $f(x)=-3\sqrt{x}$ on the interval $[0,c]$ is equal to $-6.$
worked_solution:
To solve for $c,$ we apply the average value formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{b-a}\,{\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\ -6 & =\frac{1}{c-0}\,{\int }_{0}^{c}(-3\sqrt{x})\,\text{d}x \\ -6 & ={\frac{1}{c}(-2{x}^{3/2})|}_{0}^{c} \\ -6 & =\frac{1}{c}[(-2{c}^{3/2})-(0)] \\ -6 & =-2\sqrt{c} \\ \sqrt{c} & =3 \\ c & =9\end{aligned}
$$
